android-smssdk-integration 1.0.0

- Initial release with a complete interactive 6-step workflow for integrating MobTech SMSSDK (短信验证) into Android projects.
- Guides users through project path validation, SMSSDK config Excel generation and validation, Gradle/environment setup, privacy compliance, and code integration.
- Supports both built-in UI and custom UI integration with user confirmation and code insertion instructions at each step.
- Provides compliance reminders for privacy policy according to regulatory requirements.
- Step-by-step process ensures correctness and reduces manual integration errors.
